title: Dulles brothers draft the Versailles war reparations

tellings.quote: and actually as lawyers at Sullivan and Cromwell that to draft into the into the Verasai treaty agreement the war reparations requirements

plain: Dan Sheehan, a researcher and lawyer, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that the brothers Allen and John Foster Dulles, then young lawyers at the New York law firm Sullivan and Cromwell, helped write the war reparations, the payments demanded from Germany, into the Treaty of Versailles that ended the First World War in 1918 and 1919. He ties this to their relatives Robert Lansing and John W. Foster, and he tells it to show how early the brothers were near the center of power.
